title: GSE frozen free-query token validity and action-track feasibility
purpose: Determine whether frozen exit-token confidence, five-frame causal persistence or three-seed geometry consensus can safely reject ghost queries while retaining enough physical exits to form structural action sets.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only C01-C08 frozen-token validity audit; zero training, new inference, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated observable exit Teacher arrays.
Sealed action-transport, direct relational-event V1 and exact-one V2 evidence.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained frozen outputs.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Use every sealed C01-C08 observation and all six slots of all three seeds once; causal averages reset at traversal boundaries and use at most the current plus four past observations.

teacher.source: Sealed observable directed-exit mask, identity, heading and opening width from the deduplicated Teacher.
teacher.use: Teacher validity and identity are attached after frozen heading-plus-width assignment only to score each seed. Neither enters confidence, temporal transport or cross-seed consensus.
teacher.valid_mask: Each visible Teacher exit is assigned to one of six queries; unassigned queries are negative. Padded Teacher slots remain excluded.
teacher.student_input: No student training or new inference. Scores replay frozen confidence, descriptor, heading, width and vertical profile only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or planner is executed.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies descriptive metrics only; no gradients or fitting.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None; evaluate all realizable tied thresholds and report the best recall at the pre-existing 0.995 precision floor.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only sealed C01-C08 data, frozen predictions and three named sealed evidence packages are read.

methods.main: Compare each frozen query's current confidence with a past-only five-frame descriptor-transported confidence mean and Teacher-free three-seed heading/width/profile consensus. All ranking thresholds include complete score ties.
methods.baseline: Current single-frame confidence plus sealed V1 state-machine and V2 exact-one direct-event results.
methods.fallback: If safety-level token recall and improvement fail, stop the frozen free-query validity route and prepare a dense circular traversability-field Teacher that has no free-query objectness.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 252430 frames, 188126 observations, C07/C08 21548/24394, and per seed 396913 positive plus 731843 negative slots.
acceptance.retained_capacity: Teacher action-set macro-F1 and all-seed descriptor transport precision/recall remain at least 0.98.
acceptance.validity: Every seed retains at least 0.50 token recall at precision at least 0.995.
acceptance.corrective: For every seed, five-frame or three-seed geometry evidence both retains at least 0.50 high-precision recall and improves average precision by at least 0.05 over current confidence.
acceptance.system: All shard/cache hashes match; zero optimizer/new inference/threshold fitting/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE.

failure_policy: Any source, join, label, causal-boundary, assignment, tie-threshold or isolation ambiguity fails closed. A scientific failure stops this representation rather than changing gates.
retention: Retain JSON/CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, raw log, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal as paper ablation and representation-selection evidence.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU read-only full shard verification, three causal transports and three-seed geometry consensus
